papers.title: Microstructure, Properties, and Metallurgical Defects of an Equimolar CoCrNi Medium Entropy Alloy Additively Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选择性激光熔化制备等原子比CoCrNi中熵合金的微观结构与性能，虽涉及AM工艺和力学测试，但未涉及生物医学应用或多孔结构应力屏蔽等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration, which are central to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM制备等原子比CoCrNi中熵合金的可行性及工艺-组织-性能关系。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备试样，并进行微观表征与力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了致密试样，明确了缺陷类型及微观结构对性能的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EBSD和拉伸实验验证组织与力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility and process-microstructure-property relationships of an equimolar CoCrNi medium entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by SLM and characterized using microscopy and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Dense samples were obtained, and the influence of defects and microstructure on mechanical properties was clarified.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through SEM, EBSD, and tensile tests.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties of a high Mg-content Al-Mg-Sc-Zr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for potential structural applications.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying process parameters and characterized by tensile testing, hardness measurement, and microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibits refined grains and superior mechanical properties, but no biomedical or implant-related evaluations were performed.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through standardized tensile tests and microstructural observations.

papers.title: 4D Biofabrication Using a Combination of 3D Printing and Melt-Electrowriting of Shape-Morphing Polymers
papers.abstract: We report the fabrication of scroll-like scaffolds with anisotropic topography using 4D printing based on a combination of 3D extrusion printing of methacrylated alginate, melt-electrowriting of polycaprolactone fibers, and shape-morphing of the fabricated object. A combination of 3D extrusion printing and melt-electrowriting allows programmed deposition of different materials and fabrication of structures with high resolution. Shape-morphing allows the transformation of a patterned surface of a printed structure in a pattern on inner surface of a folded object that is used to align cells. We demonstrate that the concentration of calcium ions, the environment media, and the geometrical shape of the scaffold influences shape-morphing that allows it to be efficiently programmed. Myoblasts cultured inside a scrolled bilayer scaffold demonstrate excellent viability and proliferation. Moreover, the patterned surface generated by PCL fibers allow a very high degree of orientation of cells, which cannot be achieved on the alginate layer without fibers.

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate scroll-like scaffolds with anisotropic topography for guided cell alignment using 4D printing.
summary_en.method: A combination of 3D extrusion printing of methacrylated alginate and melt-electrowriting of polycaprolactone fibers was used to create bilayer structures that shape-morph into folded tubes.
summary_en.result: Myoblasts cultured in the scrolled scaffolds showed excellent viability and proliferation, and the patterned PCL fibers induced a high degree of cell orientation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments validated biocompatibility and cell alignment capabilities.

papers.title: NUMERICAL MODELING THE EFFECTS OF ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING PARAMETERS, HEAT TREATMENT AND ORIENTATION ON RESIDUAL STRESS AND DISTORTION OF METAL POWDER IN718 PUMP IMPELLER FABRICATION
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) technology based on IN718 powder bed by means of finite element method (FEM) has been concerned with effects of additive manufacturing (AM) parameters, heat treatment and part orientation on residual stress and distortion of IN718 pump impeller. It is found that fabrication in horizontal position has the least and vertical position has the most residual stress and distortion between considered conditions. Also, increasing the speed of the process is very efficient and reduce the residual stress and distortion of the process up to 65% and heat treatment is beneficial in reducing the distortion in most of the conditions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究IN718泵叶轮的增材制造残余应力，无任何生物医学植入物或骨整合相关背景，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on a pump impeller (turbomachinery) with no biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration, and no implant-related mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造参数、热处理和取向对IN718泵叶轮残余应力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 基于有限元方法模拟选择性激光熔化过程。
summary_zh.result: 水平取向残余应力最小，垂直取向最大；提高速度可降低应力达65%。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of additive manufacturing parameters, heat treatment, and part orientation on residual stress and distortion of IN718 pump impellers fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A finite element model was developed to simulate the SLM process for IN718 powder bed and predict residual stress and distortion under various conditions.
summary_en.result: Horizontal orientation yielded the lowest residual stress and distortion, while vertical orientation yielded the highest; increasing scanning speed reduced residual stress by up to 65%.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely numerical without experimental validation.
